name: Ownership
definition: We take ownership of our work. We think long-term and bias toward long-term value over short-term results. We act on behalf of the entire company, beyond just our own team.

rows.under: We only make sure that "the hole is not in my side of the boat". Refuse to take responsibility to get a result.
rows.justRight: We consistently give and set clear expectations, and do the work to meet them. We practice "no surprises". We assist a fellow team lead who is struggling by offering to help as an individual contributor, rather than by taking control.
rows.over: Take ownership of everything and do not let others do their job. Impose on others' responsibilities and disempower them.
